title: Bumper Carts
statement: Carts roll along a straight track. `carts[i]` describes cart `i` from left to right: its size is the absolute value, and a positive value rolls right while a negative value rolls left. All carts move at the same speed. When a right-rolling cart meets a left-rolling cart, the smaller one is knocked off the track; if they are the same size, both are. Carts rolling the same way never meet. Return the carts left at the end, from left to right.

answerKey.pattern: Stack of surviving carts; a left-rolling cart fights the right-rolling carts on top
keyPoints: Only a right-rolling cart on the left meets a left-rolling cart on the right
For a left-rolling cart, while the top rolls right and is smaller, pop it
If the top is the same size, pop it and drop the new cart; if the top is bigger, drop the new cart
If no right-rolling cart is left on top, push the new cart
answerKey.timeComplexity: O(n): each cart is pushed and popped at most once
edgeCases: Left-rolling carts at the start never meet anything
One big left-rolling cart knocks off many
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Simulate the track step by step: much slower

hints: Which pairs of carts can meet at all?
Keep the carts that survive so far on a stack. A new left-rolling cart meets the top first.
Pop smaller right-rolling carts in a loop; handle equal sizes and a bigger top; push only if the new cart survives.
